## Overview

`PhenotypeReport` helps epidemiologists summarize and report on OHDSI phenotype
definitions using results produced by a
[Strategus](https://github.com/OHDSI/Strategus) pipeline run.

The typical workflow is:

1. Simulate or point to a Strategus results folder
2. Create a settings object
3. Call `get*` functions to read data from the results folder
4. Call `table*` functions to render formatted tables for your report

---

## Step 1: Simulate a results folder

If you do not yet have a Strategus results folder, use
`simulateStrategusResults()` to create one for exploration and testing.

```{r simulate}
library(PhenotypeReport)

simData <- simulateStrategusResults(nDatabases = 3, nCohorts = 4, seed = 42)
str(simData, max.level = 1)
```

Write the simulated data to disk with `writeStrategusResults()`. Pass the path
you want to use as the Strategus results folder; one sub-folder per database
will be created directly inside it.

```{r write, eval=FALSE}
outputFolder <- tempfile("phenotype_report")
writeStrategusResults(simData, outputFolder)

# Folder structure produced:
# outputFolder/
#   synpuf/
#     DatabaseMetaData/
#       database_meta_data.csv
#     CohortGeneratorModule/
#       cg_cohort_definition.csv
#       cg_cohort_count.csv
#     CohortDiagnosticsModule/
#       cd_incidence_rate.csv
#       cd_index_event_breakdown.csv
#       cd_concept.csv
#   ambnet/
#     ...
```

```{r write-hidden, include=FALSE}
outputFolder <- tempfile("phenotype_report")
writeStrategusResults(simData, outputFolder)
```

---

## Step 2: Create a settings object

`createSettings()` points the package at your results folder. The `minYear`
and `maxYear` parameters are required and control which calendar years are
included in incidence over time analyses. Use `cohortIds` to restrict the
report to a specific subset of cohorts.

```{r settings}
# Include all cohorts
settings <- createSettings(
  resultsFolder = outputFolder,
  minYear = 2010L,
  maxYear = 2023L
)
settings

# Or restrict to specific cohort IDs
settings <- createSettings(
  resultsFolder = outputFolder,
  cohortIds     = c(1L, 2L),
  minYear       = 2010L,
  maxYear       = 2023L
)
settings
```

---

## Step 3: Read database information

`getDatabaseInformation()` reads `DatabaseMetaData/database_meta_data.csv` and
returns a plain data frame — one row per database.

```{r get-db}
dbInfo <- getDatabaseInformation(settings)
dbInfo[, c("cdm_source_name", "cdm_version", "vocabulary_version",
           "max_obs_period_end_date")]
```

---

## Step 4: Render a table for your report

`tableDatabaseInformation()` takes the data frame from the previous step and
returns a formatted `gt` table ready for inclusion in an R Markdown or Quarto
document.

```{r table-db}
tableDatabaseInformation(dbInfo)
```

---

## Step 5: Read cohort counts

`getCohortCounts()` reads cohort counts and definitions from
`CohortGeneratorModule/` and returns a long data frame with one row per
database-cohort combination. The `cohortIds` specified in `createSettings()`
are applied here — if all cohorts are desired, leave `cohortIds = NULL`.

```{r get-counts}
counts <- getCohortCounts(settings)
counts
```

---

## Step 6: Render a cohort counts table

`tableCohortCounts()` pivots the data wide and renders a `gt` table with one
row per cohort and one column group per database, showing both persons and
events.

```{r table-counts}
tableCohortCounts(counts)
```

---

## Step 7: Plot cohort counts

`plotCohortCounts()` produces a grouped bar chart of person counts by cohort
and database.

```{r plot-counts, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
plotCohortCounts(counts)
```

---

## Cohort Incidence

`getCohortIncidence()` reads `CohortIncidenceModule/ci_incidence_summary.csv`
and returns incidence rates and proportions stratified by overall, age group,
and gender.

```{r get-incidence}
ci <- getCohortIncidence(settings)
```

Both `tableCohortIncidence()` and `plotCohortIncidence()` accept the same
`stratifyBy` vector. Tables use gt column spanners to group strata levels;
an **Overall** level is always included for each strata dimension. For
combinations involving `"year"`, year appears as rows with Overall at the top.

### Overall

```{r table-incidence-overall}
tableCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = "overall")
```

```{r plot-incidence-overall, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
plotCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = "overall")
```

### Age

```{r table-incidence-age}
tableCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = "age")
```

```{r plot-incidence-age, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
plotCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = "age")
```

### Gender

```{r table-incidence-gender}
tableCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = "gender")
```

```{r plot-incidence-gender, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
plotCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = "gender")
```

### Year

```{r table-incidence-year}
tableCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = "year")
```

```{r plot-incidence-year, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
plotCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = "year")
```

### Age + Gender

Nested spanners: outer = age group, inner = gender.

```{r table-incidence-age-gender}
tableCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = c("age", "gender"))
```

```{r plot-incidence-age-gender, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
plotCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = c("age", "gender"))
```

### Year + Gender

```{r table-incidence-year-gender}
tableCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = c("year", "gender"))
```

```{r plot-incidence-year-gender, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
plotCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = c("year", "gender"))
```

### Year + Age

```{r table-incidence-year-age}
tableCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = c("year", "age"))
```

```{r plot-incidence-year-age, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
plotCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = c("year", "age"))
```

### Age + Gender + Year

```{r table-incidence-age-gender-year}
tableCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = c("age", "gender", "year"))
```

```{r plot-incidence-age-gender-year, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
plots <- plotCohortIncidence(ci, stratifyBy = c("age", "gender", "year"))
for (p in plots) print(p)
```
